verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a direct Claude Code integration in which Claude Code triggers CodeRabbit reviews and then fixes the issues found. Its pricing lists "loops with coding agents," and its IDE review runs inside Cursor and other VS Code-based editors. Coding Plans can also be handed off to any coding agent, though that covers plans rather than review findings. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of copyable per-finding fix prompts, any documented Codex integration, a clear Cursor-agent handoff beyond the IDE extension, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent loop.
